cards.name: Coalition Flag
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature you control
Enchanted creature is a Flagbearer.
While an opponent is choosing targets as part of casting a spell they control or activating an ability they control, that player must choose at least one Flagbearer on the battlefield if able.

cards.name: Coalstoke Gearhulk
cards.oracleText:
Menace, deathtouch
When this creature enters, put target creature card with mana value 4 or less from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control with a finality counter on it. That creature gains menace, deathtouch, and haste. At the beginning of your next end step, exile that creature.

cards.name: Coalborn Entity
cards.oracleText: {2}{R}: This creature deals 1 damage to target creature token, player, or planeswalker.

cards.name: Coalition Victory
cards.oracleText: You win the game if you control a land of each basic land type and a creature of each color.

cards.name: Coalition Relic
cards.oracleText:
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{T}: Put a charge counter on this artifact.
At the beginning of your first main phase, remove all charge counters from this artifact. Add one mana of any color for each charge counter removed this way.

cards.name: Coal Stoker
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, if you cast it from your hand, add {R}{R}{R}.

cards.name: Coalhauler Swine
cards.oracleText: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, it deals that much damage to each player.

cards.name: Coalition Construct
cards.oracleText:
As Coalition Construct enters, choose a creature type.
Coalition Construct is the chosen type in addition to its other types.
When Coalition Construct enters, other creatures you control of the chosen type and creature cards of that type in your hand perpetually get +1/+1.

cards.name: Coal Hill School
cards.oracleText:
Whenever a player casts a historic spell, that player draws a card. (Artifacts, legendaries, and Sagas are historic.)
Whenever chaos ensues, return target historic card from your graveyard to your hand.
